crossRefs.note: “I have made you a tester of metals and a fortress among my people, that you may know and try their way.
He said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they do? Even the great abominations that the house of Israel commit here…
They will comfort you, when you see their way and their doings; then you will know that I have not done all that I have…

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Don’t you see what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
translations.bsb: Do you not see what they are doing in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
translations.kjv: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
translations.asv: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
